title: Fox Denounces 'Psychological Torture' of Detained Ex-Governor Ruffo Appel at Altiplano Prison
detail: Vicente Fox appears alongside Verónica Ruffo, daughter of detained former Baja California governor Ernesto Ruffo Appel, and PAN leaders to escalate his defense of Ruffo, held at the Altiplano federal maximum-security prison since his July 2026 arrest on organized-crime and fuel-smuggling ('huachicol fiscal') charges. Fox declares 'meto la mano al fuego por Ernesto Ruffo' (I put my hand in the fire for Ernesto Ruffo) and accuses authorities of psychologically mistreating his longtime PAN colleague, saying 'no tiene madre que le hayan hecho eso' (it's unforgivable what they did to him) and announcing expanded legal representation. The statement extends Fox's late-July 'political prisoner' framing of the Ruffo case.

media.caption: Fox denounces alleged psychological torture of detained ex-governor Ernesto Ruffo Appel at the Altiplano prison
